title: A ruling
$comment: Deliberately no $id. The rule schema publishes itself at an https identifier because implementations validate rule files against it; a ruling is authored only in this repository, so an https $id here would be a URL that does not resolve.

id.description: Permanent identifier. Never renumbered, never reused.

headline.description: The decision in one line, as it is cited in conversation.

question.description: What was open before the ruling. Omitted where the headline is the whole of it.

decision.description: What was decided and why. Implementation-independent, like a rule's normative text.

decided.description: When. Omitted where the date was not recorded; never invented.

affects.description: Every rule that cites this ruling. Kept in step with those rules' `rulings` lists by the validator, in both directions.

supersedes.description: A ruling is never rewritten. Where one turns out to be wrong, a later ruling supersedes it and says so.
